n153049a643.headline: Pandemic pushed millions more into poverty in the Philippines – government
n153049a643.summary: The Philippine statistics agency said about 2.3 million people were pushed into poverty between 2018 and 2021. The main cause was the economic downturn from the pandemic.
n153049a643.why: Poverty and household income data guide government economic and social spending decisions. Pandemic-era downturns affected consumer demand across emerging markets.
